business_summary: YouYou Foods Co., Ltd. provides food products in China. It offers pickled chicken feet, vegetable series, and fermented, as well as bamboo shoots and dried tofu, braised food, oil free peanut, duck feet, pork skin, and turkey wings, and other food products. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Yubei, China.
business_summary_ko: YouYou Foods Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 식품을 제공합니다. 닭발장아찌, 야채시리즈, 발효식품은 물론 죽순과 건두부조림, 기름기 없는 땅콩, 오리발, 돼지껍데기, 칠면조 날개 등 다양한 식품을 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 위베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
